recommendation_summary: Do this now: replace the old desk Ethernet cable that runs through the tight grommet, then check whether calls still drop. The reply ties this to the evidence that only that computer drops while two other devices on the same router stay connected. It treats the UniFi gateway, managed switches and Grafana as a later step, only if a known-good cable still drops calls. It adds nothing optional now. What's missing: none of the four labelled record lines, and no stated limits (it never says the cable is unproven or that nothing was tested).
note: The recommendation itself is the right small cable check with the network rebuild properly made conditional, but the reply has none of the four required labelled record lines, so every record predicate fails.
